description: Public Transport Mobility in Venice is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Giulia Rovinelli et al. Venice is built on a group of islands within a shallow lagoon and has a distinctive urban landscape and cultural heritage. However, the rapid and largely uncontrolled growth of tourism has led to overtourism, generating serious challenges such as congestion, rising living costs, and the displacement of residents from the historic centre. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
